newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FIVE MLN LITAS BID IN C.BANK'S REPO AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: FIVE MLN LITAS BID IN C.BANK'S REPO AUCTION.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Tuesday that one commercial bank bid five million litas at its third repurchase auction.
"One commercial bank bid five million litas at an annual interest rate of 6.79 percent today," the deputy head of the central bank's market operations department, Renata Sidoravichiene, told Reuters.
The central bank offered 15 million litas to repurchase government T-bills at a minimum 6.75 percent annual interest rate with seven days maturity, Sidoravichiene said.
The next repo auction is scheduled for August 8.

The introduction of repo auctions is the first stage of the central bank's gradual plan to regain the monetary policy instruments it lost when Lithuania adopted its currency board system in the spring of 1994.
